fields.label: Test checkpoint
fields.options: Development test only. All punches skip auto attendance. Offline claims require HR review. Face verification is not yet enabled.

fields.label: Test Employee
fields.description: Choose only your dedicated Mobile Test employee. This login must use the custom punch API.

fields.label: Require GPS Workplace Check for Test Punches
fields.description: Enable only after configuring an enabled Mobile Attendance Workplace for the test employee's company. Both IN and OUT require a fresh precise location.

fields.label: Require Approved Device for Test Punches
Enable Offline Test Claims
fields.description: Approved devices only. Original time, photo and GPS upload within seven days. Enable automatic test acceptance to skip routine HR review.

fields.label: Require Punch Photo and GPS
fields.description: Record the time when the punch button is pressed, then take a photo and capture GPS. Photos are private evidence; no identity or liveness verification is performed.

fields.label: Enable Mobile Site Connection
fields.description: Publish only the public client ID and site label for employee onboarding. This does not enable attendance.

fields.label: Mobile Public OAuth Client
fields.description: Authorization Code, Code response, Token Endpoint Auth Method None, all scope, MAAS redirect URI.

fields.label: Use Company Test Policies
fields.description: Select a dedicated test employee per company using Mobile Attendance Company Policy. Site online/offline switches remain emergency gates; site evidence requirements are minimums.

fields.label: Enable Production Attendance
fields.description: Requires explicit employee enrollment, enabled company policy and an approved device. Production checkins do not skip automatic attendance.

fields.label: Enable Production Offline Claims
fields.description: Uploaded original evidence awaits HR review. Approval creates a production checkin.

fields.label: Automatically accept valid test offline punches
fields.description: Dedicated test employees only. Requires photo/GPS evidence and an approved device. Does not mark daily attendance.

fields.label: Enable Face Recognition Pilot
fields.description: Allows HR to enroll employee face photos and test matches. Does not create checkins. Record employee consent before enrolling.

fields.label: Face Match Threshold
fields.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0.2 to 0.9). Raise it to reduce wrong matches; tune with Test face match on real staff photos.

fields.label: Face Match Margin
fields.description: The best employee must lead the next one by at least this much (0 to 0.3), otherwise the result is ambiguous.
